principle_violations.reason: The DebitCardPaymentProcessor class mixes responsibilities of payment processing and authorization checks. Similarly, the Order class has responsibilities beyond just holding order data.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate payment processing and authorization responsibilities into different classes or use a separate service for handling payments and authorizations.

principle_violations.reason: The DebitCardPaymentProcessor is tightly coupled with the SMSAuthorizer, which means higher-level modules depend on lower-level modules.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an abstraction for the authorizer so that the payment processors depend on this abstraction instead of a concrete implementation.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
